subject: refactor(ssh_dotnet): static terminal helpers + drop dead stream fields (S2325/S1144)
body:
refactor(ssh_dotnet): static terminal helpers + drop dead stream fields (S2325/S1144)

- Make the pure key-sequence/colour helpers static: GetCtrlSequence, GetAltSequence,
  GetKeySequence, GetPrintableSequence, ParseColor (S2325).
- Remove the write-only _sshStream/_streamAttached fields (S1144): the protocol drives
  shell I/O directly, so the terminal never read them. Attach/DetachSshStream become
  thin logging markers (also dropping two generic catches); AttachSshStream no longer
  takes the unused stream param. Updated the single caller + the test.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Refactors SSH_DotNet terminal control. This protocol is an unmerged experimental feature not present in our fork, so this commit does not apply.
